title: Reader Journey Metric Selector Layout Audit v4.2
defect: DEFECT-UAT-009 Metric Selector Overlays Journey Content
note: Audit completed before any z-index / coordinate patch. No Book/Chapter/Run special cases.

root_cause.summary: 当前指标 uses JourneyAnchoredMenu portal dropdown (position:fixed) anchored below the trigger; the panel paints over PhaseNavigation and CanonicalJourneyChart instead of participating in MainJourneyPane document flow.
why_covers_phase_and_chart: Menu is createPortal(..., document.body) with position:fixed; top = trigger.bottom + 6
Menu does not reserve layout height in .journey-overview-curve flex column
Phase strip and chart remain at their original Y; fixed menu draws on top
Solid background exists on panel, but metric option text still visually overlaps Phase cards and chart marks in the screenshot because the panel occupies the same viewport region

MetricSelectorMenu.top_left: computed from trigger getBoundingClientRect; prefer below; flip above if needed
MetricSelectorMenu.width_height: minWidth max(coords.width,200); max-width min(320px, 100vw-16px); max-height min(70vh,420px); overflow auto
MetricSelectorMenu.clientRect_inference: Overlaps Phase strip + active-scene caption + chart top when open on typical 1366–1920 heights
MetricSelectorMenu.affected_by_MainJourneyPane_scroll: Repositions on scroll capture (window scroll listener true); still overlays content rather than pushing it

PhaseNavigation.overflow: hidden on wrap; strip overflow-x auto

CanonicalJourneyChart.overflow: hidden on shell/viewport per v4.1 scroll ownership
CanonicalJourneyChart.z_index: auto; node tooltip card z-index 40 in CSS

MainJourneyPane.notes: Metric portal escapes Main overflow; not clipped; therefore overlays siblings visually

ancestor_overflow_chain.overflow: hidden on workspace shell; panes scroll internally
viewport; fixed menu not clipped by Main

stacking_context.metric_menu: new stacking via position:fixed + z-index:50 on body
stacking_context.phase_and_chart: normal flow under Main; no competing z-index against fixed menu
stacking_context.inspector: grid column / bottom dock; not the cause of DEFECT-UAT-009

required_fix.metric_selector: in-flow MetricSelectorPanel between Toolbar and PhaseNavigation
